episodes.title: Hamle Mein 12 Din Baaki
episodes.hook: Bade Chacha's hologram threatens Dhamaka in the first frame.
episodes.logline: A failed alien commander is sent to conquer Earth and lands in a housing-society parking lot.
comedy: a tiny sad 'pfft' instead of a boom
an invasion stopped by a parking sticker

engage.pinned: Aapki society mein sabse strict aunty kaun hain? Ek line mein batao.
engage.share: Aunty vs alien, instantly recognisable to anyone who lives in a society.
engage.clue: The pink ring necklace in the framed photo on the console (visible in later reels).

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha's huge green hologram head glares down and wags a finger at the camera.
shots.line: Prithvi jeet ke aana beta, warna ghar mein entry band.
shots.sfx: static crackle, a low alien drone

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka stands on top of the dented orange pressure-cooker ship, cape flapping, ray gun raised, gem blazing red.
shots.line: Prithvi walon! Ab hoga... DHAMAKA!
shots.sfx: the ship's whistle blasts seeeeti, then a tiny sad pfft instead of a boom

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Sharma Aunty marches into frame with her clipboard and points straight at the ship.
shots.line: Ullu ke pathe! Hamla karne se pehle parking sticker dikhao!
shots.sfx: a sharp whistle blow, a clipboard tapped

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu peeks out of the ship hatch holding a samosa and speaks to camera.
shots.line: Baarah din baaki! Aap Aunty ke fine se kaise bachoge?

episodes.title: Parking Mein UFO
episodes.hook: A pressure-cooker spaceship slams onto a scooter and whistles; Dhamaka is mid-threat.
episodes.logline: Dhamaka lands on someone's scooter in Sundar Vihar Society and is fined by the secretary before he can attack.
comedy: the villain speech interrupted by 'yeh kiska scooter hai?'
a fine for shouting at midnight
'Gadbadi paisa' vs 'hum sirf UPI lete hain'
Mausi's mom-voice in the middle of a war

engage.pinned: Aapki society ka sabse ajeeb rule kaun sa hai? Aunty ko dikhana hai.
engage.share: Anyone who has been fined by an RWA will send this.
engage.clue: Look at the console in the last shot: a small framed photo.

episodes.tease: Aunty ne ek notice chipka diya hai.

shots.camera: wide, ship slams in, then fast push-in on Dhamaka
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: The orange pressure-cooker ship crashes onto a parked scooter, steam shoots from its whistle, Dhamaka leaps out and then looks down.
shots.line: Prithvi walon, kaanp jao! Main tumhara ant... arre! Yeh kiska scooter hai?!
shots.sfx: a heavy thud, the ship's whistle seeeeti, a flattened-scooter squeak

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu peers out of a round porthole at the flattened scooter below.
shots.line: Sir ji, scooter ne chhoti si cheekh maari. Hamari galti nahi hai na?
shots.sfx: a creak of bent metal, a nervous gulp

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka points his ray gun up at a dark apartment block as window lights switch on one by one.
shots.line: Imarat ke maalik! Bahar aao, ullu ke pathe, warna sab bhasm kar dunga!
shots.sfx: his echo off the walls, window latches, a distant dog barks

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: A balcony light flicks on; Sharma Aunty marches down in a night-suit with a torch and clipboard.
shots.line: Barah baje cheekh rahe ho? Bhasm baad mein, pehle paanch sau rupaye.
shots.sfx: a torch click, slippers slapping on stone

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka's eyes go wide, his gem flickers from red to pink for a second, and his voice squeaks.
shots.line: Paanch sau?! Main Gadbad ka commander hoon! Mere paas toh Gadbadi paisa hai!
shots.sfx: a small gem flicker, a comic squeak

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty tears off a strip of tape and sticks a paper notice on the ship's hatch.
shots.line: Gadbadi paisa? Hum sirf UPI lete hain. Yeh dibba hatao. Sticker kahan hai?
shots.sfx: a tape rip, a paper slap

shots.camera: close-up on the glowing orb, Dhamaka sulking out of focus behind
shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: Mausi's pearl orb pulses pink while Dhamaka sulks behind her; a small framed photo is just visible on the console.
shots.line: Beta, daal-chawal garam hai. Hamla kal bhi ho jayega. Pehle khaana.
shots.sfx: a soft pulse hum, a spoon on a steel plate

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu sits with a steel plate of daal-chawal and talks to camera.
shots.line: Kal main kya khaaun? Aap batao, aur kyun?

episodes.title: Namaste, Ullu Ke Pathe
episodes.hook: Chintu whispers to camera that the aliens learned Hindi from TV, then ducks.
episodes.logline: Chintu realises the aliens speak soap-opera Hindi, charges them for lessons, and Dhamaka cannot stop adding an insult to every greeting.
comedy: 'saas, bahu, saazish' as a life philosophy
verbal tic: namaste + insult
a 12-year-old invoicing a commander in UPI

engage.pinned: Dhamaka ko ek serial wala dramatic dialogue sikhana hai. Aap kya likhoge?
engage.share: 'Namaste... ullu ke pathe' is the quotable line.
engage.clue: Chintu's notebook has a drawing of the pink gem.

episodes.tease: Chintu ke paas ek aur business idea hai.

shots.camera: close-up, Chintu peeking round a scooter, notebook in hand
shots.speaker: chintu
shots.action: Chintu whispers straight to camera, then ducks as Dhamaka's boots stomp past.
shots.line: Ye aliens ko Hindi TV ne sikhayi hai. Ab main inhe business sikhaunga!
shots.sfx: a sneaky creak, heavy boots on gravel

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka looms over Chintu and points the ray gun at his nose.
shots.line: Insaan ke bachche! Le chal mujhe tere neta ke paas, nalayak!
shots.sfx: a gun charge-up whine, a bird squawk

shots.speaker: chintu
shots.action: Chintu pushes the gun barrel aside with one finger and flashes his gap-toothed grin.
shots.line: Bhaiya, neta nahi, Aunty hain. Par pehle batao, aapne Hindi kahan se seekhi?

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka clutches his chest in a melodramatic pose, whiskers trembling.
shots.line: Pandrah saal serial dekhe hain! Saas, bahu, saazish... yahi toh jeevan hai!

shots.speaker: chintu
shots.action: Chintu counts on his fingers like a teacher.
shots.line: Pehla lesson: jab milo, toh bolo namaste. Bas namaste. Aur kuch nahi.

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka presses his palms together stiffly, then covers his own mouth in horror.
shots.line: Namaste... ullu ke pathe. Arre! Yeh muh se kyun nikalta hai?!
shots.sfx: a squeaky voice crack, his whiskers twitch

shots.camera: medium shot, Chintu holding out a phone with a QR code
shots.speaker: chintu
shots.action: Chintu holds out his open palm and a phone to Dhamaka like a shopkeeper.
shots.line: Teen sau ki class thi, bhaiya. UPI ya cash? Business ki baat hai.
shots.sfx: a coin jingle, a phone ping

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu holds Chintu's notebook upside down and reads from it.
shots.line: Dhamaka ko ek serial wala dialogue sikhao. Aap kya likhoge?

episodes.title: Gadbad Ka Itihaas
episodes.hook: Bade Chacha sits in a documentary chair and announces his people were once the angriest in the universe.
episodes.logline: A deadpan documentary about planet Gadbad: how anger powered it, how they won every war and got bored, and how Earth's TV made them forget their own language.
comedy: total gravity over silly facts
mountains still in shock
a planet that cried at serials for fifteen years

engage.pinned: Agar aapke ghar mein sirf ek TV serial chalta rahe, toh woh kaun sa hoga?
engage.share: Anyone with a serial-addicted parent will send this.
engage.clue: Bade Chacha's throne has a small empty chair next to it.

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha sits on his golden throne like a documentary interviewee, ruby gem glowing, hands folded.
shots.line: Hum Gadbadi, kabhi poore brahmaand ke sabse gusse waale log the.
shots.sfx: a slow swelling documentary score, a throat clear

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha lifts his chin and gestures grandly as the lamps flicker.
shots.line: Humare veer cheekh se pahaad tod dete the. Pahaad aaj bhi sadme mein.
shots.sfx: a distant rock crash echo, the score swells

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha shrugs very slightly, completely serious.
shots.line: Phir hum saare yudh jeet gaye. Dushman khatam. Gussa khatam. Bijli khatam.

shots.camera: medium close-up, lamps dimming behind him
shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: The glowing orange lamps behind him dim one by one as his frown deepens.
shots.line: Hum itne bore ho gaye ki ek hafte tak sirf chhat dekhte rahe.
shots.sfx: lamps powering down one by one, a sad horn

shots.camera: medium shot, Bhondu rushing in with a small TV
shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu runs in carrying a tiny old television, antenna sparking, eyes wide.
shots.line: Chacha ji! Aasman se jaadu aa raha hai! Log rote bhi, nachte bhi!
shots.sfx: TV static, running feet, a soap-opera sting

shots.camera: over-the-shoulder, the TV glowing on the wall
shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha stares at the glowing TV, mesmerised, a tear rolling down his cheek.
shots.line: Humne pandrah saal serial dekhe. Saas, bahu, saazish... hum sab rote rahe.
shots.sfx: a soap-opera theme tune, a sob

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha blinks slowly, still staring at the TV, face blank.
shots.line: Hum apni bhasha bhool gaye. Ab sirf serial wali Hindi aati hai.
shots.sfx: the soap tune fading, a sad trombone

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha turns from the TV and speaks directly to camera, dead serious.
shots.line: Ab Prithvi ka gussa chahiye. Aap hote toh kya karte?

episodes.title: Pehla Samosa
episodes.hook: Bhondu cries tears of joy with crumbs on his face.
episodes.logline: Bhondu tastes his first samosa and falls in love with Earth. Dhamaka bans it, then eats one in secret and his gem turns pink: the show's rule appears.
comedy: an alien overwhelmed by an ordinary snack
'tumhe kaise pata?' vs a nagging computer
the commander's hypocrisy

engage.pinned: Aapki society ka sabse bada Aunty kaun hai? Naam mat batana, bas ek line mein batao.
engage.share: Everyone has a samosa moment; people will send it to the friend who eats one at every meeting.
engage.clue: Mausi says she remembers three samosas from his childhood. How?

episodes.tease: Bade Chacha ka call aane waala hai.

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu holds a samosa in both long hands, tears rolling and crumbs on his chin.
shots.line: Sir ji... yeh tikona... mere mooh mein baarish ho rahi hai!

shots.camera: medium shot, Dhamaka snatching the samosa
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka grabs the samosa and holds it away from Bhondu like evidence.
shots.line: Samosa?! Dushman ka khaana! Isse phenk do, bevakoof!

shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: Mausi's orb pulses softly while she speaks to the room.
shots.line: Beta, tum bachpan mein teen khaate the. Mujhe sab yaad hai.

shots.camera: medium close-up, Dhamaka squinting at the orb
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka squints suspiciously at the orb, the samosa still in his fist.
shots.line: Tumhe kaise pata? Tum toh kal hi install hui ho!

shots.camera: close-up on the orb, pulsing quickly
shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: The orb pulses a nervous pink and wobbles in the air.
shots.line: Data hai, beta. Computer hoon. Ab samosa khao, thanda ho raha hai.
shots.sfx: a nervous pulse, a spoon clink

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka chews, eyes closed in bliss, the gem on his forehead fading from red to soft pink.
shots.line: Hmm... yeh kitna... kamina... swaadisht hai.
shots.sfx: a slow chew, a soft gem fade-out chime

shots.camera: close-up on the orb, Dhamaka frozen behind
shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: The orb turns toward Dhamaka's pink gem while he freezes mid-chew.
shots.line: Gem gulabi ho gaya, commander sahab. Ab hamla kaise karoge?

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu holds half a samosa and whispers to camera.
shots.line: Aapki society ka sabse bada Aunty kaun? Batao!

episodes.title: Gadbad Ki Sabha
episodes.hook: A brass bell is struck and an entire hall shouts 'Breaking news!' at once.
episodes.logline: The Gadbad council argues like an Indian TV news debate, decides to take Earth's anger, and sends Dhamaka because nobody else raises a hand.
comedy: a council run like a TV debate
Bhondu cares about samosas, not conquest
the loudest silence in the galaxy: 'koi bhi?'
Tej's silent plan

engage.pinned: Aapke ghar mein family debate kis topic par sabse zyada hota hai?
engage.share: Every Indian family has this debate at dinner.
engage.clue: Tej and Chacha's secret look in the last shot.

shots.camera: wide shot, then a fast push-in on the throne
shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha slams a brass bell on the arm of his throne as a hall of unseen voices shouts at once.
shots.line: Order! Order! Sabha shuru! Pehli khabar: hamari bijli khatam ho rahi hai!
shots.sfx: overlapping off-screen voices yelling 'Breaking news!', a bell clang

shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej stands with perfect posture and a calm smile while unseen voices shout around him.
shots.line: Prithvi par har jagah gussa hai. Traffic mein, ghar mein, news mein.

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu raises one long hand timidly from the back row.
shots.line: Aur wahan samosa bhi milta hai, sir ji. Garam, tikona, chutney ke saath.
shots.sfx: a tiny squeak of a chair

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha thumps his armrest and points a trembling finger at the ceiling.
shots.line: Samosa baad mein! Pehle ek commander jaayega Prithvi jeetne.
shots.sfx: a thump, a gasp from off-screen

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha scans the hall, then raises one hand himself as if showing how.
shots.line: Haath upar karo, jo jaana chahta hai. Koi? ...Koi bhi?
shots.sfx: total silence, then a single cricket chirp

shots.camera: medium shot, Dhamaka stumbling to his feet at the back
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka stands up too fast, bumps the table, and raises his hand with a bright hopeful face.
shots.line: Chacha ji! Main jaaunga! Main taiyaar hoon!
shots.sfx: a table bump, a hopeful squeak

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha slowly looks Dhamaka up and down, then sighs deeply.
shots.line: Dhamaka... theek hai. Tum jaoge. Koi aur taiyaar nahi tha.
shots.sfx: a long sigh, one lonely cough

shots.camera: extreme close-up on Tej's eyes sliding to Bade Chacha
shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej smiles warmly at Dhamaka, then his eyes slide sideways to meet Bade Chacha's in a secret look.
shots.line: Best of luck, Dhamaka bhai. Main sab dekh raha hoon.

episodes.title: Paani Ka Bill
episodes.hook: Dhamaka holds the water tank hostage with a ray gun.
episodes.logline: Dhamaka tries to cut Earth's water by threatening the rooftop tank. Aunty reminds him of three months of unpaid bills and signs him up as a member.
comedy: a hostage situation where the hostage is a plastic tank
'udhaar sirf Sharma ji ki dukaan par'
'welcome' as a trap

engage.pinned: Aapki society mein maintenance ke paise kaun sabse late deta hai?
engage.share: Maintenance dues humour, extremely sendable to the building group.
engage.clue: The form Dhamaka signs has a drawing of the pressure-cooker ship.

episodes.tease: Bade Chacha ne call kiya hai.

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka stands on the terrace, ray gun aimed at a big black plastic water tank.
shots.line: Prithvi walon! Tumhari paani ki tanki meri bandhak hai! Haath upar!

shots.camera: medium shot, Aunty storms up the stairs
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty bursts through the stair door, clipboard raised like a weapon.
shots.line: Haath upar tum karo! Teen mahine ka bill baaki hai. Paani kaise aayega?

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka puffs out his chest, whiskers quivering, voice cracking.
shots.line: Main commander hoon! Mere naam par toh udhaar chalna chahiye!

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty lifts one eyebrow and taps the clipboard.
shots.line: Udhaar sirf Sharma ji ki dukaan par milta hai. Yahan sirf maintenance.

shots.camera: medium shot, Bhondu stooping into frame
shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu pulls a half-eaten samosa out of his uniform pocket and offers it.
shots.line: Sir ji, mere paas aadha samosa hai. Kya usse bill bhar sakte hain?

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka grudgingly signs a form on Aunty's clipboard, his gem dimming to pink.
shots.line: Theek hai! Jeet gayi tum, Aunty... par agle hafte main zaroor jeetunga!

shots.camera: close-up, a sweet but terrible smile
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty takes the clipboard back and smiles like a trap closing.
shots.line: Sign kar diya? Welcome to the society. Meeting har Sunday, subah aath baje.

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu sits on the plastic chair on the terrace, clutching the form like a trophy.
shots.line: Aapki society ka sabse ajeeb rule kya hai?

episodes.title: Dhamaka Ka Result
episodes.format: send-off with a nagging mother figure
episodes.hook: Dhamaka stares at his spaceship and cries 'Yeh toh pressure cooker hai!'
episodes.logline: Dhamaka is handed a cheap pressure-cooker ship and a brand new computer called Mausi. Before leaving he puts his missing mother's photo on the console.
comedy: 'budget kam tha'
'yeh computer hai ya kisi ki Mummy?'
the guilt-trip before launch

engage.pinned: Aapki Mummy ka sabse famous dialogue kaun sa hai?
engage.share: Mom-nagging lines are the most sent content in Indian families.
engage.clue: The photo: a round orange alien woman with a pink ring necklace.

shots.camera: wide shot through the arched window onto a launch pad, then close-up on Dhamaka
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka stands at the arched window, staring at the dented orange pressure-cooker ship on the launch pad.
shots.line: Chacha ji! Yeh toh pressure cooker hai!
shots.sfx: a whistle blows from the ship, a creak

shots.camera: medium close-up, Chacha waving a dismissive hand
shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha waves one hand lazily, not meeting his eyes.
shots.line: Budget kam tha, beta. Wahan chawal bhi pakega, hamla bhi hoga.

shots.camera: medium shot, Chacha tapping a glowing orb on a pedestal
shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha taps a glowing pearl-white orb sitting on a pedestal beside him.
shots.line: Naya computer lagaya hai. Naam Mausi. Uski baat maan lena.
shots.sfx: a soft chime from the orb

shots.camera: close-up on the glowing orb inside the ship
shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: Mausi's pink ring of light pulses warmly as she greets him for the first time.
shots.line: Beta, namaste. Yaad rakhna, pehle khaana, phir hamla.
shots.sfx: a warm hum, the soft ring pulse

shots.camera: close-up, Dhamaka squinting at the orb
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka tilts his head at the orb with narrowed eyes.
shots.line: Yeh computer hai ya kisi ki Mummy? Itna kyun bolti hai?

shots.camera: medium shot, Bhondu wedged in the hatch
shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu squeezes his long frame through the round hatch, knees folded, holding a small bag.
shots.line: Sir ji, main bhi chalunga. Aap akele mat jaana.

shots.camera: close-up on a small framed portrait, then on Dhamaka's face
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka places a small framed portrait of a round, kind orange alien woman wearing a glowing pink ring necklace on the console, and touches it.
shots.line: Mummy, kahin bhi ho, main jeet ke aaunga.
shots.sfx: a soft sniff, a quiet engine hum

shots.camera: close-up on the orb, ring pulsing slowly
shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: Mausi's ring pulses slowly once, then quickly as she snaps back to nagging.
shots.line: Chalo beta. Seat belt lagao. Khaana thanda ho raha hai.
shots.sfx: a gentle pulse, then the ship's whistle seeeeti

episodes.title: Beta, Result Aaya?
episodes.hook: Bade Chacha's hologram asks the question every Indian kid dreads.
episodes.logline: Dhamaka's uncle compares him with Tej. Dhamaka lies; Mausi calls him 'my child' by mistake; Bhondu cannot lie.
comedy: 'Sharma-ji ka beta' in alien form
a lie that grows by the second
Bhondu protects the honour of the samosa

engage.pinned: Aapko lagta hai Mausi kaun hai, aur kyun?
engage.share: 'Beta, result aaya?' is the most relatable line in Indian homes.

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha's green hologram head fills the screen, one wrinkled eyebrow raised.
shots.line: Dhamaka! Tej ne teen grah jeet liye. Tumhara result kahan hai?

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka stands rigid with a fake smile and a very shaky thumbs up.
shots.line: Chacha ji! Prithvi ka chalis percent jeet liya! Bas thoda aur baaki hai!

shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: Mausi's orb dims slightly and pulses with dry sarcasm.
shots.line: Chalis percent? Tumne toh bas ek fine jeeta hai.

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha frowns, his white moustache feelers drooping.
shots.line: Mausi se kaho itna na bole. Ladka kamzor ho jaata hai.

shots.camera: close-up on the orb, pulsing fast
shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: The orb flares bright pink with sudden defensive energy.
shots.line: Mera bachcha kamzor nahi hai, Chacha ji. Bas bhookha hai.

shots.camera: medium two-shot, Dhamaka whispering to Bhondu
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka grabs Bhondu's long arm and whispers urgently.
shots.line: Bhondu, tu bhi bol de 'Prithvi jeet liya'. Warna samosa band.

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu looks down at his hands with huge wet eyes.
shots.line: Sir ji, main jhooth bolunga toh samosa ka apmaan hoga.

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu holds a samosa in both hands and stares at camera, serious.
shots.line: Aapko lagta hai Mausi kaun hai? Aur kyun?

episodes.title: Honk Honk
episodes.format: power-up montage with a dance-break surprise
episodes.hook: Dhamaka's gem is blazing red because he is stuck behind a car.
episodes.logline: Dhamaka discovers Indian traffic is an endless source of anger and powers up. Then a distant baraat band makes his feet dance, and the power vanishes.
comedy: traffic jam as a power plant
the dhol takes over his body
Mausi recorded the dance

engage.pinned: Kaun si cheez aapko sabse zyada gussa dilati hai?
engage.share: Dancing against his will to a dhol is instantly sendable.
engage.clue: Mausi says she recorded the dance. Why does she keep his videos?

episodes.tease: Society ke WhatsApp group ka dhamaka.

shots.camera: low-angle, tight lane between parked cars
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka's ship is stuck behind a hatchback in a narrow lane; he leans out of the hatch, gem blazing red.
shots.line: Hata gaadi, harami! Raasta de, warna main tujhe bhasm kar dunga!

shots.camera: medium shot, Bhondu looking up from the passenger seat
shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu points at Dhamaka's glowing red gem with wide wonder.
shots.line: Sir ji, aapka gem laal-laal chamak raha hai. Aap toh bijli ho gaye!

shots.camera: close-up, Dhamaka grinning like a villain
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka looks around at the honking cars and cackles.
shots.line: Traffic jam! Yeh toh gusse ki khaan hai! Bhaiyon-behno, mera time aa gaya!

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka thrusts his arms up, gem erupting in red light as nearby cars rattle.
shots.line: Gusse se bhar jao, mere gem! Ab hoga... DHAMAKA!
shots.sfx: a huge boom that shrinks into a car-horn squeak

shots.camera: medium close-up, Aunty on her scooter
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty glares at her scooter's horn, which is now stuck and honking forever.
shots.line: Mere scooter ka horn atak gaya! Aath sau rupaye lagenge!
shots.sfx: a stuck horn that never stops

shots.camera: low-angle shot on Dhamaka's feet then face
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: A distant dhol and shehnai begin to play; Dhamaka's feet start to dance on their own, gem fading to pink.
shots.line: Yeh dhol meri haddiyon mein kyun ghus raha hai?! Main nachna nahi chahta!
shots.sfx: a distant dhol and shehnai, shuffling feet

shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: Mausi's orb sways gently in time with the distant music.
shots.line: Gem gulabi ho gaya, beta. Dance toh acha tha. Video bana li hai.
shots.sfx: a warm hum, the dhol far away

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu mimics a tiny dance step and then stops, embarrassed, and talks to camera.
shots.line: Kaun si cheez aapko sabse zyada gussa dilati hai?

episodes.title: Good Morning Group
episodes.hook: Dhamaka stares in horror at a phone buzzing with 300 notifications.
episodes.logline: Aunty adds the aliens to the society WhatsApp group. Dhamaka declares war on Good Morning flowers while Bhondu becomes the beloved 'Alien Uncle'.
comedy: every Indian family group
the villain loses to a thumbs-up emoji
Mausi adds her own greeting

engage.pinned: Aapke family group mein sabse zyada kaun bolta hai?
engage.share: Every group has that one person; guaranteed sends.
engage.clue: Mausi asks for a heart emoji. Who still uses hearts like that?

episodes.tease: Aunty ke paas ek naya hathiyar hai.

shots.camera: extreme close-up on a buzzing phone, then on Dhamaka's face
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: A phone buzzes on the console; Dhamaka holds it at arm's length with his whiskers standing on end.
shots.line: Teen sau notification! Yeh kaun hai jo har subah phool bhejta hai?!

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty sips chai on the terrace, tapping her own phone with a smug smile.
shots.line: Society group mein add kiya hai. Sabko subah Good Morning bolna padta hai.
shots.sfx: a chai sip, a phone tap

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka shakes the phone, gem flaring red.
shots.line: Good Morning?! Main subah shraap deta hoon, phool nahi!
shots.sfx: an angry phone shake, a ding

shots.camera: medium shot, Bhondu typing with giant fingers
shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu types with one huge finger and beams as the phone lights up.
shots.line: Sir ji, maine thumbs up bheja. Sab mujhe 'Alien Uncle' bol rahe hain.

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka throws his cape over his shoulder in outrage.
shots.line: Alien Uncle?! Main Commander hoon! Group se delete karo, sabke liye!

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty wags a finger at the camera like a school teacher.
shots.line: Group chhodoge toh fine. Aur kal Verma ji ko Happy Birthday zaroor bolna.

shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: The orb pulses a warm pink glow.
shots.line: Beta, meri taraf se bhi sabko Good Morning bhej do. Heart emoji lagana.

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu holds the phone in both hands, delighted, and talks to camera.
shots.line: Aapke family group mein sabse zyada kaun bolta hai?

episodes.title: Dimaag Control
episodes.format: status reversal: the villain becomes the servant
episodes.hook: Dhamaka fires a mind-control ray straight at Aunty.
episodes.logline: Dhamaka tries to hypnotise Aunty. She lifts a steel thali, the ray bounces back, and he obeys her every word. Mausi slips and says 'Mummy'.
comedy: a steel plate beats alien technology
the villain turns into an obedient helper
Mausi's slip

engage.pinned: Aunty ne Dhamaka se aur kya karwaya hoga? Ek kaam batao.
engage.share: 'Jo bhejoge, wahi wapas aayega' is an instant Aunty-isms quote.
engage.clue: Mausi says 'Dhamu' and 'Mummy' in the same breath.

episodes.tease: Ek chamakti hui nayi spaceship aasman mein.

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka aims a glowing mind-control helmet-cannon at Aunty across the lot.
shots.line: Sharma Aunty! Ab tum meri gulam banogi! Dimaag-control kiran, chalo!
shots.sfx: a charging whine, then a laser zap

shots.camera: medium shot, Aunty lifts a steel thali like a shield
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty lifts a gleaming steel thali with both hands, calm as a cobra.
shots.line: Beta, yeh steel ka thaal hai. Jo bhejoge, wahi wapas aayega.
shots.sfx: a metallic ping, a deflected zap

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka stands with spiral eyes and a goofy smile, gem flickering.
shots.line: Aunty ji, kya hukum hai? Chai banaun ya gaadi saaf karun?

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty points a finger at the ship and then at a row of dusty scooters.
shots.line: Pehle ship ko sticker lagao. Phir saari scooters saaf karo. Aur muskurao!

shots.camera: medium shot, Dhamaka saluting in a robot voice
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka stiffly salutes and marches in a straight line with a frozen grin.
shots.line: Jo hukum, Aunty ji. Jo hukum. Jo hukum. Muskura raha hoon.

shots.camera: medium close-up, Bhondu whispering from behind the ship
shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu peeks round the ship's leg, holding a samosa on a plate.
shots.line: Sir ji, wapas aao! Samosa thanda ho raha hai! Mausi ro rahi hai!
shots.sfx: a loud whisper, a plate clink

shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: The orb flashes pink as if she is panicking.
shots.line: Dhamu, jaag jao! Beta, yeh Mummy... yaani ship ki Mausi bula rahi hai!

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu stares at the orb, then slowly turns to camera, eyes wide.
shots.line: Mausi ne abhi kya bol diya? Aapne suna?

episodes.title: Sharma-Ji Ka Beta
episodes.hook: A shiny alien descends in a shower of sparkles and compliments Dhamaka's 'process'.
episodes.logline: Commander Tej-Tarrar arrives, perfect and polite. He reveals Dhamaka was only the decoy: the Gussa-Pinjra fires in four days.
comedy: perfect cousin energy
a villain who doesn't know what an NOC is
Dhamaka's insult backfires on himself

engage.pinned: Aapke life ka 'Sharma ji ka beta' kaun hai?
engage.share: Everyone has a Sharma ji ka beta. Instantly sendable.
engage.clue: Tej's glance at Bade Chacha last time. Now we see why.

episodes.tease: Dhamaka ko ek dhoka mila hai.

shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej descends in a column of sparkling light, cape perfectly still, and lands without a hair out of place.
shots.line: Namaste Dhamaka bhai. Main Tej-Tarrar. Aapka process dekh ke bahut seekha.

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka stomps forward, whiskers trembling.
shots.line: Tej! Tu yahan kya kar raha hai, chamchagiri ke ullu ke pathe?

shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej adjusts his cuff with a gleaming smile.
shots.line: Chacha ne bheja hai. Aap trailer the, bhai. Main picture hoon.

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka's gem flares red, his voice breaks.
shots.line: Trailer?! Mera result aaya nahi, tera kaise aa gaya, harami?

shots.camera: medium shot, Tej lifting a glowing cage device
shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej holds up a glowing golden cage device the size of a lunchbox.
shots.line: Gussa-Pinjra tayyar hai. Teen din mein poori Prithvi hamari battery.

shots.camera: medium close-up, Aunty from her balcony
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty leans over her first-floor balcony railing with a mug in hand.
shots.line: Pinjra? Society mein koi bhi device lagane se pehle NOC chahiye.
shots.sfx: a balcony door slide, a mug clink

shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej stares blankly, blinking once, then looks down at his device as if it might explain.
shots.line: NOC... kya hota hai? Kya yeh koi naya weapon hai?

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu peeks round the ship and speaks to camera.
shots.line: Aapke life ka 'Sharma ji ka beta' kaun hai?

episodes.title: Dhokha
episodes.hook: Dhamaka shouts 'Dhoka!' in slow motion with three dramatic zooms.
episodes.logline: Dhamaka confronts Bade Chacha in full soap-opera style. Chacha admits he was a decoy. Aunty watches from her balcony like it is her favourite serial.
comedy: triple-zoom TV melodrama
'main chacha hoon, baap nahi'
Aunty becomes the audience

engage.pinned: Aapko lagta hai Dhamaka ki Mummy kahaan hai?
engage.share: Soap-opera parody; people send it to the family member who watches serials.
engage.clue: Dhamaka asks for his Mummy, and the orb answers softly.

episodes.tease: Chintu ke paas ek jugaad hai.

shots.camera: slow-motion dramatic zoom, three quick zooms
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka throws his cape back in slow motion, wind blowing his whiskers, three dramatic push-ins.
shots.line: Chacha ji! Aapne mujhe dhoka diya! Main aapka apna khoon hoon!
shots.sfx: a thunder sting, dramatic soap-opera music stabs

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha shakes his head sadly, hologram flickering.
shots.line: Khoon? Beta, main tumhara chacha hoon. Baap nahi. Ghar ki baat alag hai.

shots.camera: extreme close-up on Dhamaka's tearful eyes
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka's eyes fill with tears and his whiskers droop, three slow zooms on his face.
shots.line: Toh... meri Mummy kahaan hai?!

shots.speaker: bade-chacha
shots.action: Bade Chacha looks away from the camera, avoiding the question.
shots.line: Plan B mein tum decoy the. Mujhe maaf karna, beta. Business hai.

shots.camera: close-up on Bhondu eating and crying
shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu bawls into a samosa, crumbs and tears flying.
shots.line: Sir ji... aapka dukh dekh ke mere samose mein aansoo gir gaye!

shots.camera: medium shot through the balcony railing
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty watches from her balcony with a mug, completely hooked.
shots.line: Yeh kaunsa serial hai? Mujhe poora episode dekhna hai, chai le aati hoon.
shots.sfx: a distant echo of the drama, a mug sip

shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: The orb glows a warm, trembling pink toward Dhamaka.
shots.line: Beta, maine tumhe apni goad mein khilaya hai. Ab rona band karo.

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu wipes his tears with the corner of a samosa wrapper and speaks to camera.
shots.line: Aapko lagta hai Dhamaka ki Mummy kahaan hai?

episodes.title: Jugaad Plan
episodes.hook: Chintu chalks a plan on the tarmac: 'Mission Aunty Khush'.
episodes.logline: The cage runs on anger and Aunty is the angriest person on Earth, so Chintu's plan is to keep Aunty calm for one full day.
comedy: a heist about being polite
'rule ek: koi galat parking nahi'
Aunty becomes suspicious

engage.pinned: Aapke ghar mein sabse jaldi gussa kaun hota hai?
engage.share: 'Make mom/aunty/dad not angry for a day' is a universal mission.
engage.clue: Aunty says 'kuch toh gadbad hai'. The word gadbad is the planet's name.

episodes.tease: Kal. Aunty ko gussa nahi dilana.

shots.camera: overhead shot of a chalk plan, then a push-in on Chintu
shots.speaker: chintu
shots.action: Chintu draws a heist plan on the tarmac in chalk with the others gathered around.
shots.line: Mission 'Aunty Khush'. Pinjra sirf gusse se chalta hai. Gussa nahi, machine nahi.

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka stares at the chalk plan, whiskers trembling.
shots.line: Asambhav! Aunty ko toh saans lene par bhi gussa aata hai!

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu holds out a plate of samosas with both hands.
shots.line: Sir ji, hum usse samosa dedete hain. Aur chutney bhi. Extra.

shots.camera: medium shot, Chintu pointing to the plan
shots.speaker: chintu
shots.action: Chintu taps the chalk drawing with a stick, serious as a general.
shots.line: Rule ek: koi galat parking nahi. Koi shor nahi. Koi fine nahi.

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka raises one finger like a nervous student.
shots.line: Aur agar Aunty ne mujhe 'ullu ke pathe' bol diya toh?

shots.camera: medium shot, Chintu with a cheeky grin
shots.speaker: chintu
shots.action: Chintu flashes his gap-toothed grin and pats Dhamaka's arm.
shots.line: Toh bolna: 'Dhanyavaad, Aunty ji'. Customer hamesha sahi hota hai.
shots.sfx: a pat, a tiny coin jingle

shots.camera: close-up from the balcony, eyes narrowing
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty watches from her dark balcony, eyes narrowing behind her glasses.
shots.line: Sab itne meethe kyun hain aaj? Kuch toh gadbad hai.

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu holds the stick Chintu used as a pointer, imitating a general.
shots.line: Aapke ghar mein sabse jaldi gussa kaun hota hai?

episodes.title: Aunty Ka Mood: Loading...
episodes.hook: Dhamaka bows absurdly low to Aunty and says she looks like the sunrise.
episodes.logline: The whole day is spent being very polite to Aunty while her mood bar loads. It almost works until Tej slips a parking challan under her scooter's wiper.
comedy: a villain trying to be nice
Aunty detects fake kindness in three seconds
'jab Aunty chup ho jaaye'

engage.pinned: Aapko lagta hai Aunty ka gussa kitne percent tak jaayega?
engage.share: 'Jab Aunty chup ho jaaye, toh samajh jaana toofan aa raha hai' is the quote.
engage.clue: Aunty's mood bar overlay in Vids climbs from 0 to 99 percent.

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka bows at ninety degrees with a gigantic fake smile, his cape dragging on the ground.
shots.line: Namaste, Aunty ji. Aaj aap bahut sundar lag rahi hain. Bilkul sunrise jaisi.
shots.sfx: a stiff cape drag, a nervous giggle

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty narrows her eyes and leans in, clipboard clutched to her chest.
shots.line: Dhamaka, tune tanki phodi? Ya lift tod di? Sach bata, kya kiya?
shots.sfx: a clipboard clutch, a suspicious hum

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu presents a bunch of marigolds and a samosa on a paper plate.
shots.line: Aunty ji, yeh phool, yeh samosa, aur yeh mera dil. Gussa mat hona.

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty takes the flowers and sniffs them with deep suspicion.
shots.line: Phool? Samosa? Dil? Mujhe seedha batao, kitne ka nuksaan hua hai?!

shots.camera: medium close-up, Dhamaka whispering to the orb
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka whispers into a small steel walkie-talkie that glows with a soft pink ring of light.
shots.line: Mausi, Aunty gussa nahi hui. Hum jeet rahe hain!

shots.camera: close-up on the walkie-talkie in his hand
shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: The walkie-talkie's pink ring pulses worriedly, flickering, as Mausi's voice comes through.
shots.line: Beta, jab Aunty chup ho jaaye, toh samajh jaana toofan aa raha hai.

shots.camera: medium shot, Tej strolling past Aunty's scooter
shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej strolls by with a smile and tucks a yellow challan slip under Aunty's scooter wiper.
shots.line: Aunty ji, scooter par challan. Teen sau rupaye. Bas process follow kiya.
shots.sfx: a paper slip, a smug chime

shots.camera: extreme close-up on Aunty's raised eyebrow
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty slowly turns, one eyebrow rising in extreme close-up.
shots.line: Mere... scooter... par... challan?

episodes.title: Hamla Ka Din (Part 1): Aunty Ka Gussa
episodes.format: action set-piece with a censor bleep
episodes.hook: A giant golden beam strikes from the sky onto Aunty.
episodes.logline: The cage fires and Aunty's fury is unleashed (and bleeped). Dhamaka rushes to save her with his own anger and learns the machine feeds on it.
comedy: Mausi bleeping the tirade
Dhamaka's first real DHAMAKA makes things worse
Tej cheering the wrong side

engage.pinned: Aunty ki tirade mein beep ke peeche kya tha, aapko kya lagta hai?
engage.share: The bleeped Aunty tirade is made for sending.
engage.clue: The real DHAMAKA finally works. And that's the problem.

shots.camera: wide, golden beam from the sky
shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: A golden cage-beam descends from the sky onto the parking lot, Tej standing in front of it, arms spread.
shots.line: Gussa-Pinjra, shuru! Sharma Aunty ka gussa poori Prithvi ko le jaao!
shots.sfx: a rising mechanical roar, a deep golden hum

shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: Aunty rises in the beam, hair flying, steel thali raised like a trident.
shots.line: Tum! Challan! Mere scooter par! Ullu ke pathe, harami, tumhari toh...
shots.sfx: a wind roar, a loud censor BEEP over her last word

shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: Mausi's orb floats out of the ship for the first time, flashing pink, and zips between Aunty and the kids.
shots.line: Bacche sun rahe hain, Aunty ji! Maine beep laga diya!

shots.camera: medium shot, Tej reading a glowing meter
shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej stares at a glowing meter on his device, needle far in the red.
shots.line: Gussa ninyaanve percent! Yeh Aunty rukti hi nahi!
shots.sfx: a machine whine, a ticking meter

shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka charges forward, gem blazing red and cape streaming, and slams his fists together.
shots.line: Aunty ji! Main bachaunga! Meri taaqat dekho! Ab hoga... DHAMAKA!
shots.sfx: a roar, a real thunderous boom, a shockwave

shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: The cage glows brighter around Dhamaka's shockwave, and the orb pulses frantically.
shots.line: Beta, ruko! Mat karo! Tumhara gussa machine ko khilata hai! Meter dekho!
shots.sfx: a frantic pulse hum, a rising machine whine

shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej raises both arms in cheerful encouragement at Dhamaka.
shots.line: Haan! Aur gussa, Dhamaka bhai! Process bilkul sahi chal raha hai!
shots.sfx: a cheerful chime, a machine whine

shots.camera: extreme close-up on Dhamaka's frozen face
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka freezes mid-charge, gem flickering between red and pink, mouth open.
shots.line: Matlab... mujhe gussa nahi... khush hona padega?

episodes.title: Hamla Ka Din (Part 2): Dhamaka Nahi, Dhanyavaad
episodes.hook: Dhamaka tries to laugh and fails in the funniest way possible.
episodes.logline: Dhamaka learns to laugh at himself. The cage collapses, Tej is beaten by paperwork, and Mausi reveals she is his mother. Then a giant shadow covers the parking lot.
comedy: a villain who cannot laugh
the cage defeated by joy
the Mausi-is-his-mother reveal
a parking-sticker gag at mothership scale

engage.pinned: Season 2 mein aapko kya dekhna hai?
engage.share: The reveal and the last line are both made to be sent.
engage.clue: Everything: Mausi's lines, the photo, the ring, 'pehle khaana'. Rewatch from reel 1.

shots.camera: medium close-up, Bhondu tickling Dhamaka with a samosa
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka tries to laugh with a stiff face while Bhondu tickles him with a samosa.
shots.line: Haha... haa... Arre! Mujhe toh hasna hi nahi aata!
shots.sfx: a stiff fake laugh, a tickling squeak

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu gently holds Dhamaka's cheek with one big hand.
shots.line: Sir ji, yaad karo. Wo pehla samosa. Wo chutney. Wo jannat.
shots.sfx: a gentle melody under the dawn wind

shots.camera: low-angle, Dhamaka bursts into real laughter
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka bursts into real laughter, tears in his eyes, his gem turning a brilliant blue-white.
shots.line: Haha! Wo tera chehra tha na, jab pehla samosa khaya! Bevakoof!
shots.sfx: a genuine belly laugh, a gem chime

shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej's device sparks and sputters as the golden beam flickers and fades.
shots.line: Machine band ho rahi hai?! Hasi...? Yeh kaunsa weapon hai?!
shots.sfx: a failing machine whine, a sputter

shots.camera: medium close-up, Aunty panting and calmed
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: The beam fades and Aunty lowers her thali, panting, hair settling.
shots.line: Arre, thandi hawa chali. Tej beta, challan phaad do aur sticker lo.

shots.speaker: tej-tarrar
shots.action: Tej looks down at his device, then up at Aunty, defeated and small.
shots.line: Sticker kahan milta hai? Main toh bas process follow kar raha tha...

shots.camera: close-up on the orb, soft sunrise light
shots.speaker: mausi
shots.action: Mausi's orb glows soft pink and warm gold as sunrise hits her.
shots.line: Dhamu, mera bachcha. Aaj tune apni Mummy ko bahut proud kiya.
shots.sfx: a tender hum, a faint sob

shots.camera: extreme close-up on Dhamaka, jaw dropped
shots.speaker: dhamaka
shots.action: Dhamaka's jaw drops, his whiskers straighten, his gem pulses once.
shots.line: M-M-Mummy?! Tum... tum ship ho?!
shots.sfx: a record scratch, a gem chime

shots.camera: wide, a vast shadow covers the parking lot, Aunty's face lit in its glow
shots.speaker: sharma-aunty
shots.action: A colossal mothership slides across the sky and casts a shadow over the whole society; Aunty shades her eyes with her clipboard.
shots.line: Ab yeh itna bada dibba kiska hai? Sticker dikhao!
shots.sfx: a deep horn, a building rumble

shots.speaker: bhondu
shots.action: Bhondu pops up in front of the shadow, holding a samosa, and speaks to camera.
shots.line: Doosre season mein aapko kya dekhna hai? Batao!
